claims: Mother's Day (Mothering Sunday) in the UK in 2026 is on Sunday, 15 March.
Mother's Day (Mothering Sunday) in the UK is celebrated annually on the fourth Sunday of Lent.
Mother's Day (Mothering Sunday) in the UK falls three weeks before Easter Sunday.
Mother's Day (Mothering Sunday) in the UK is historically known as Mothering Sunday.
Mothering Sunday marks a day when people returned to their "mother church".
The date of Mother's Day (Mothering Sunday) in the UK changes annually.
The date of Mother's Day (Mothering Sunday) in the UK always falls within March.
